metrics.label: JMA pressure-curve similarity
metrics.definition: (1 + centred cosine similarity) / 2 at exact common UTC leads; no shift, time warp or lag optimization. At least six common points and non-flat truth and both forecasts. Removes level and amplitude, so read with pressure MAE and actual hPa curves.
